summary: Frontend-only QA of the MOTORISATIONS RÉELLES lot (5/5 scenarios PASS). (1) Admin login OK → /livre/settings → 'Gérer les véhicules & affectations (18)' sheet opens with the 'Motorisation' column and 18 fuel-type selects. Values verified exactly as expected: LOGITRAK AUDI = 'Essence', 5-Alliance 01 = 'Essence', all 16 others = 'Inconnue' (KAIO Renault Zoe, Skoda Enyaq BE 579 928, KAIO Skoda Enyaq 07, KAIO Volvo EX30 08, 1-Enyaq 01 Bern all correctly 'Inconnue' — no name-guessed 'Électrique'). (2) Admin edit: AUDI changed to 'Diesel' → toast 'Motorisation mise à jour' shown, value persisted after full page reload (= Diesel), then RESTORED to 'Essence' and re-verified after reload (AUDI = Essence, Alliance = Essence — production values restored, no other vehicle touched). (3) RBAC manager (manager@logitrak.ch): sheet opens, fuel-type select is disabled (is_disabled()=True, visually greyed, click times out / no options open) while the 'Mode' select (settings-vehicle-mode-LOGITRAK-AUDI) stays enabled. (4) Rapprochement (/livre/energie/rapprochement, période Année en cours, table loaded ~1-2 min): LOGITRAK AUDI row = 'Thermique' + 28.0 L with badge 'Périmé' (Mesuré / Exploitable); 5-Alliance 01 = 'Thermique'; exactly 16 rows 'Motorisation inconnue'; zero occurrences of 'Électrique' and zero fabricated 0 L. (5) Non-régression Journal & trajets (/livre/history/pro): loads normally, 500 rows, 'Carb. (est.)' column present with 500 non-null L values (historique non recalculé). No console errors, no error elements.

issues: Minor test-flakiness observed: immediately after a fuel-type change the SelectTrigger element is detached/replaced for a few seconds by the full load() refetch (Playwright locator timed out for ~30s on the same data-testid before the row re-appeared). Functionally correct (value persisted) but a targeted state update instead of a full load() would avoid the row flicker.

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage.jsx changeVehicleFuelType calls the full load() after every change — consider optimistic/local state update to avoid re-fetching the whole settings payload and re-mounting the 18-row table.
Fuel-type select uses `disabled={user?.role !== 'admin'}` while the Mode select uses `canEdit` — two different gating mechanisms in the same table; centralise the RBAC predicate to avoid drift.
SettingsPage.jsx is 527 lines and mixes settings sections + vehicle sheet + BLE tag cell; consider extracting the vehicles sheet into its own component.
seed_data_creation: None. AUDI fuel_type temporarily set to diesel then restored to essence; Alliance untouched (essence); 16 others left null (Inconnue). No other setting modified.
